metadata.description: Claude Code Plugin: hybrid bash→PowerShell transpiler for Windows. POSIX pass-through, targeted rewrites, MSYS path translation.

plugins.name: claude-code-win32
plugins.description: Makes Claude's Bash tool calls work cleanly on Windows: POSIX pass-through via Git Bash, PowerShell rewrites for common Unix idioms, MSYS drive-path translation, and deny-with-hint for Unix-only commands.
